title: Linux HATES Me – Daily Driver Challenge Pt.1
summary: Linus Tech Tips starts a series in which Linus and Luke move their home workstations to Linux. This episode has each pick a distro and try to get a game running on it, and Linus ends up breaking his Pop!_OS install.
why: HN mostly cites it as evidence of Linux's rough edges for ordinary users, including the Steam install that removed the desktop environment, and it prompted an apt fix.

quote.text: The recent Linux Challenge [0] on Linus Tech Tips has helped raise Linux's profile for gaming.
